title: ExperimentSpec bayes_decision (frozen form)
description: The optional frozen paired Bayesian decision declaration of an ExperimentSpec. This schema describes the resolved form stored in to_dict and hashed into ExperimentSpec.digest: every key is present. A declaration may omit every key except schema_version and profile; the omitted keys are filled at construction and the filled values are what is frozen. Cross-field rules (precision_half_width set, no sequential design, no cohort pin) are enforced by ExperimentSpec.validate. The Python validation is stricter than the JSON Schema keyword integer: a value written with a decimal point, such as 20000.0 or an anchor of 0.0, is rejected so one frozen value has one spelling in the digest.

rope_epsilon.description: Half-width of the region of practical equivalence. Default: the frozen effect_margin; explicit when effect_margin is 0.

prior.description: Default: one pseudo-root at difference 0 with concentration 1. All three keys are given together or not at all.

p_cut.description: Posterior probability a verdict needs. Default .95.

regression_margin.description: Per-family regression margin. Default: the frozen family_margin.

cross_check_alpha.description: One-sided level of the sign-permutation cross-check. Default 1 - p_cut, rounded to 12 decimals.
